meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 MCP 工具调用语言服务器:查看语言服务器状态、检查文件或目录的诊断错误、跳转符号定义、查找引用、列出符号,以及校验并执行重命名。
howto.when: 当 Codex 在当前工作区需要语言服务器诊断、定义、引用等能力时触发;若诊断提示缺少语言服务器,先用 lsp.status 排查。

say.text: 看看 src/index.ts 有没有报错
say.note: 调用 lsp.diagnostics 返回该文件的诊断结果

say.text: 跑一下 lsp.status,看有没有缺的语言服务器
say.note: 列出已配置、已安装、缺失的语言服务器

say.text: 找出 foo 在项目里都被哪些地方引用了
say.note: 用 lsp.find_references 返回引用位置

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can call the LSP MCP tools: check language server status, run file or directory diagnostics, jump to definitions, find references, list symbols, and check or apply workspace renames.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace; if a server is missing, run lsp.status first.

say_en.text: Check whether src/index.ts has any errors
Run lsp.status to see missing language servers
say_en.note: Lists configured, installed and missing servers

say_en.text: Find where foo is referenced across the workspace
say_en.note: Uses lsp.find_references to return the locations
